property_summary: For any caller with kilos, calling collectDrugs after sufficient elapsed time must strictly increase that caller's Kilos balance (newly produced kilos are credited); the mutant never increases Kilos in collectDrugs, so for any input with Kilos>0 and elapsed time >= 288s the buggy version leaves Kilos unchanged.
change_summary: Delete the statement that adds newly produced kilos to Kilos[msg.sender], so Kilos is never increased during collectDrugs.
